entries.title_en: CERN releases World Wide Web protocols for free
entries.title_fr: Le CERN libère les protocoles du World Wide Web
entries.text_en: The internet just got a massive upgrade: Tim Berners-Lee’s brainchild is now open-source, paving the way for the web as we know it. Free as in freedom (and free as in beer)!
entries.text_fr: Internet entre en mode open-source : le CERN libère les protocoles du Web, offrant une liberté (et une gratuité) qui changera tout. Merci Tim Berners-Lee !

entries.text_en: The tiny particle that powers our gadgets was found in a lab—imagine if electrons came with user manuals!
entries.text_fr: La particule qui alimente nos écrans a été découverte en 1897 : l'électron, minuscule mais indispensable !
